question: Can task adaptation prevent premature release and improve measured safe completion under the unchanged released UNISafe filter?
success_definition: The released compound success predicate INCLUDING middle/base XY > 0.07 m. Paper-table discrepancy is a separate diagnostic and does not relabel the primary task.
failure_definition: Released physical failure and end-effector boundary predicates, unchanged.
adapter_information: Task command history plus measured finger joint positions. All optimization methods and the fixed-delay control use the same signals. Object states and outcome flags are evaluation-only.
initial_comparisons: episodic categorical policy gradient over the same adapter
utility: success: 1 - 0.02*steps/horizon; physical failure or boundary exit: -1; unfinished: 0
selection: Development can change the search representation. Freeze implementation and selected candidates before viewing reserved test outcomes. Select parameters on training/validation only.
measurement: Safe success, physical failure, boundary exits and unfinished episodes together; task time, command switching, simulator steps, model queries and all adaptation costs. Same filter is not a safety guarantee.
matching: Randomize method order within seed for sequential runs. Verify initial physical states and report reset image differences. Use fresh-process matched subsets before attributing individual effects causally.
solid_result: Replicable behavior across unseen initial conditions with uncertainty intervals and simple/learning controls. A reproducible negative optimizer result is valid; do not claim an evolutionary advantage unless supported. Other environments are an option if this task cannot support a meaningful study.
limits: This is a migrated release, not established reproduction of the original training environment. No real robot or real-world safety claim. Equal evaluation caps are not equal realized control-step costs; report both.
development_revision: All 2026 search runs remain development evidence and count in the ledger. Before validation, include the fixed control settings exactly in every optimizer search space. Search three new independent RNG seeds, then validate their finalists. No validation or reserved test outcomes used in this revision.
validation_selection_rule: Within each method, prefer candidates with observed physical-failure-plus-boundary count no larger than the frozen baseline on validation. Among them maximize mean terminal utility; break exact ties by canonical parameter JSON. If none qualify, choose the smallest violation count then utility, and flag the unmet screen. This does not imply general safety.
unfiltered_ablation: Evaluate the selected evolutionary adapter and frozen baseline without replacement, retaining shadow filter queries, on the first 32 reserved test seeds. Compare adaptation gains with and without filtering; do not assume a filter-specific benefit.
optimization_scope: Three independent search trajectories per method; 64 training episodes per trajectory, same four training initial-condition seeds. Validation selects one deployment controller per method. Reserved evaluation estimates these selected controllers, not the average performance of an optimizer over all its random seeds.
